## What it is

The record of one request to create an account or change a person's access to a system, with the prerequisite checks, separation of duties check, approvals and provisioning, and a register of every request, as SP 800-53 AC-2 requires.

## Controls satisfied

| Control | Title |
| --- | --- |
| [AC-2](/controls/ac/ac-2/) | Account Management |
| [AC-2(2)](/controls/ac/ac-2/#ac-2.2) | Automated Temporary and Emergency Account Management |
| [AC-5](/controls/ac/ac-5/) | Separation of Duties |
| [AC-6](/controls/ac/ac-6/) | Least Privilege |
| [AC-6(2)](/controls/ac/ac-6/#ac-6.2) | Non-privileged Access for Nonsecurity Functions |

## Preview (annotated)

:::note[Guidance]
Use one form for each request: a new account, added roles, a change of access, or a temporary account. Section 5.1 of the [account management procedure](/templates/procedures/account-management-procedure/) is the process this form records. Assessors draw a sample of accounts and ask for the request behind each one, then check three things: the approval is dated before the account was created (AC-2e), the approver is not the requester (AC-5), and the prerequisites were met first (AC-2c). Most organizations hold these fields in a service management or identity governance tool rather than a document; that is fine as long as each record has them. The register at the end is also downloadable as a CSV file.
:::

| System | Request ID | Request type | Date submitted | Status |

### 1. How to use this form

- The requester completes Parts A and B. A supervisor may request for a person they supervise.
- The <span class="tpl-field tpl-org">Account manager</span> completes Parts C and D before the request goes for approval.
- The approvers complete Part E. Group and role membership needs <span class="tpl-field tpl-param">Fill in: prerequisites and criteria for group and role membership <span class="tpl-typical">Typical: a completed access request, a signed access agreement and completed security awareness training</span></span> (AC-2c), and account creation needs approval by <span class="tpl-field tpl-param">Fill in: personnel or roles required to approve requests to create accounts <span class="tpl-typical">Typical: the user's supervisor, plus the system owner or data owner for privileged roles</span></span> (AC-2e). No one approves a request for their own access.
- The <span class="tpl-field tpl-org">Account manager</span> provisions only what Part E approves, completes Part F, and enters the request in the register.
- To remove access, use the [onboarding, transfer and termination checklist](/templates/forms/onboarding-transfer-and-termination-checklist/) or a notice under section 5.5 of the account management procedure, not this form.

| --- | --- |
| Name | <span class="tpl-field tpl-fill">Fill in: full name</span> |

### Part B. Access requested

| Field | Entry |
| --- | --- |
| Account type | <span class="tpl-field tpl-fill">Fill in: individual, privileged, service, temporary, or other type the system allows</span> |
| Roles or groups requested | <span class="tpl-field tpl-fill">Fill in: role or group names, as the system defines them</span> |
| Business need | <span class="tpl-field tpl-fill">Fill in: the duties that need this access</span> |
| Information accessed | <span class="tpl-field tpl-fill">Fill in: types of information, and whether it includes personally identifiable information</span> |
| Start date | <span class="tpl-field tpl-fill">Fill in: date</span> |
| End date | <span class="tpl-field tpl-fill">Fill in: for a temporary account or a fixed-term role, the date access ends; otherwise none</span> |
| Other attributes | <span class="tpl-field tpl-fill">Fill in: restrictions to apply, from the attributes the account management procedure records for each account</span> |
| Remote access needed | <span class="tpl-field tpl-fill">Fill in: no; or yes, and the approved method from the remote access standard</span> |

The account record holds the authorized user, group and role membership, access authorizations and <span class="tpl-field tpl-param">Fill in: attributes (as required) for each account <span class="tpl-typical">Typical: an expiration date for temporary accounts, and time-of-day or location restrictions where the system supports them</span></span> (AC-2d). A temporary account is set to be disabled automatically at its end date, and an emergency account after <span class="tpl-field tpl-param">Fill in: the time period after which to automatically remove or disable temporary or emergency accounts <span class="tpl-typical">Typical: 72 hours for emergency accounts, and the end date approved at creation for temporary accounts</span></span> (AC-2(2)).

For a privileged account, the user also keeps a separate non-privileged account for email, web browsing and other nonsecurity functions (AC-6(2)). Name it here: <span class="tpl-field tpl-fill">Fill in: non-privileged account ID</span>.

:::note[Guidance]
Emergency accounts are not requested on this form: the account management procedure covers how they are used and reviewed. Request only the roles the duties need; the approver checks this (AC-6).
:::
